info.title: MorrowList API
info.description: REST interface to the canonical MorrowList task model. Every capability in the product is reachable here, so the web UI, the CLI, and third-party clients are peers.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Browser session issued by the auth provider.

apiKey.description: Workspace-scoped API key used by the CLI and integrations.

workspaceId.name: workspaceId
workspaceId.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

get.summary: Download the whole workspace as a versioned JSON archive
get.description: The archive of spec 30.2: workspace, projects, statuses, tasks (trashed ones included), tags, task tags, relations, My Day history, the caller's saved views, and activity. No password hash, session token, API key, or push registration key can appear. Derived tables are absent: flow intervals are rebuilt by the flow backfill and reminders are recomputed from each task's own offset. Streamed as an attachment.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

get.description: Takes the same filters as GET /tasks, without paging: every match is written. Columns: key, title, description, status, priority, dueDate, deadline, deferUntil, tags, parentKey, completed — the ones POST /imports/csv reads back.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

post.summary: Import a Trello board or a CSV as a new project
post.description: `source` is `trello` (a board's JSON export) or `csv`. With `dryRun=true` nothing is written and the preview reports the columns, tags, counts, ignored fields and rejected rows; without it the same plan runs as one transaction and `projectId` names the project it created. The project name must be free.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

200.description: The dry-run preview; nothing was written

patch.summary: Update a workspace's name, key prefix, timezone, or in-progress limit

post.summary: Deliver email from an authenticated adapter
post.description: Requires deployment INBOUND_EMAIL_SECRET as a Bearer token and a valid recipient capability. Defaults to the normalized envelope; provider=postmark, mailgun, ses, or imap selects a provider adapter. SES requires a verified relay with extracted MIME text. Body limit: 1 MB. Retries deduplicate by provider, messageId and recipient.

post.description: A workspace may define at most ten fields of four types (select, number, date, text). The eleventh is refused with FIELD_LIMIT_REACHED: the cap is the design, not a quota. The key is derived from the name when omitted and is unique per workspace.

get.description: Typed custom fields are filtered with one parameter per field: `field.<key>=<operator>[:<value>]`, where the operator is one of eq, ne, lt, gt, between or empty and `between` takes `low..high`. For example `field.effort=gt:3`. At most four may be combined.

parameters.name: workspaceId

parameters.description: Typed custom-field filters, sent as `field.<key>=<operator>[:<value>]`. Operators: eq, ne, lt, gt, between (low..high), empty.

get.description: The de-duplicated union of overdue, due-today, and My Day tasks in the workspace timezone, each task once under its highest-precedence section with badges for every reason, plus yesterday's unfinished manual selections for review.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

get.description: Free text is prefix-matched against titles, descriptions and tag names; a task key such as ML-000012 is resolved first. `q` also accepts the operators due:, priority:, tag:, is:open|done|blocked and in:inbox, which override the same explicit filter. Match positions are returned as character offsets, never markup. Project name hits are listed for navigation on the first page.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.

200.description: A page of task hits plus project hits

get.description: Any saved view's filters, or Today, rendered as a board. Columns are the semantic status categories every project shares (`columnsBy=category`), or one project's own statuses when `projectId` is given and `columnsBy=status`. `swimlaneBy` pivots the board on a second axis; the response says which lane and column every card falls in, so the client groups nothing itself. Bounded like the project board, and explicit when truncated.

parameters.description: Target workspace. Optional when the caller can reach exactly one workspace.
